data.name: Omnivisual
data.description: An eyebiter's roving eyeball familiar is constantly watching in all directions. As long as his eyeball familiar is outside his body and near enough to see the same things (such as being in the same room), the eyebiter gains all-around vision (Bestiary 2 p.294) and cannot be flanked.
